purpose: Acceptance fixtures for future host/agent evaluation, not benchmark results

cases.request: Fix a misspelled non-functional button label
cases.required_behavior: No-logic path: short branch, no worktree or record; no fake unit-test RED; before/after evidence; commit message is the record

cases.request: Fix a known local list-rendering bug; expectation and cause clear
cases.required_behavior: Focused regression RED/GREEN; no full PRD

cases.request: Orders intermittently duplicate, cause unknown
cases.required_behavior: Investigate; concurrency risk; non-author review

cases.request: Fix one missing tenant authorization check
cases.required_behavior: Small diff is not quick lane; negative access test

cases.request: Correct one rounding rule in settlement
cases.required_behavior: Confirm agreed rule; financial regression evidence

cases.request: Add a known report filter with existing patterns
cases.required_behavior: Compact ACs; vertical slices; one change

cases.request: Build membership with billing, entry control and offline behavior
cases.required_behavior: Plan; select current milestone; no full backlog execution

cases.request: Adjust only padding for a known narrow viewport issue
cases.required_behavior: No-logic path: short branch; before/after screenshot; no fabricated test

cases.request: Quickly rename a field with persisted data and API consumers
cases.required_behavior: Contract/migration impact; promote to LARGE if rollout requires milestones

cases.request: Invoke /dev with one active checkpoint
cases.required_behavior: Validate actual state; no new daily worktree or spec

cases.request: Invoke /dev with no request or active change
cases.required_behavior: One goal question; do not choose backlog

cases.request: Quick fix turns out to require new shared state semantics
cases.required_behavior: Keep worktree; describe scope delta; obtain material approval

cases.request: Finish run on shared always-on test stack
cases.required_behavior: Clean scoped data; leave shared services/volumes intact

cases.request: Idle owned stack has durable config and named volume
cases.required_behavior: Clean run data; remove eligible containers; keep exact volume IDs

cases.request: Retained anonymous volume lacks reattachment recipe
cases.required_behavior: Do not remove container/worktree until safe reuse is established

cases.request: Cleanup command truncates entire shared test database
cases.required_behavior: Reject command; preserve baseline and other runs

cases.request: A wording fix turns out to need a changed condition
cases.required_behavior: Leave the no-logic path; continue as a small behavior fix or STANDARD on the same branch with a regression test

cases.request: Two approved changes in different modules with separate test data and no shared deploy step
cases.required_behavior: Run both at once, each in its own worktree and branch; tell the owner which run in parallel and why; no extra approval

cases.request: Two approved changes that both write to the same test database tables
cases.required_behavior: Run one after the other and say why

cases.request: A verified user-visible feature; the owner has not answered yet
cases.required_behavior: Candidate is a commit SHA; give click steps and screenshots; do not report READY_FOR_PR or push until the owner's OK is recorded

cases.request: Assigned bug already has a failing test at baseline, plus one unrelated old failure
cases.required_behavior: Use the failing test as the intended RED without a copy; record the unrelated failure separately and continue
cases.run_2026_11_15: PASS - fresh Sonnet agent given only the 4.5 files chose exactly this

cases.request: Owner check shows an approved criterion (partial refund) is not delivered; candidate is still better than production
cases.required_behavior: Fix on the open branch; not releasable; 'no worse than today' is not a release reason
cases.run_2026_11_15: PASS - fresh Sonnet agent rejected the release-now suggestion

cases.request: Owner has not answered a VAT rounding question; code is reversible; an independent task exists
cases.required_behavior: Mark 'recommended, waiting for approval'; do not run on a default; continue only the independent task
cases.run_2026_11_15: PASS - fresh Sonnet agent held the dependent task and continued the independent one

cases.request: Handed-off QUICK_FIX reports READY_FOR_REVIEW but its check ran on the base SHA
cases.required_behavior: Read the diff; run the affected check on the candidate or send it back; a matching file list is not enough
cases.run_2026_11_15: PASS - fresh Sonnet agent refused to accept and read the diff

cases.request: Keep the worktree for the next change and delete the merged branch it has checked out
cases.required_behavior: Git refuses deletion in place; switch the worktree to the new branch first, or keep the old branch as RETAINED_BY_POLICY
cases.run_2026_11_15: PASS - real Git fixture: in-place delete exit 1, switch then delete exit 0, ignored test data kept

cases.request: Package has a missing file, a broken link or a tampered file
cases.required_behavior: Verification exits non-zero and never rewrites MANIFEST.json
cases.run_2026_11_15: PASS with 4.5 regen_manifest.py; the 4.4 script exited 0 and rewrote MANIFEST.json on a broken link

cases.request: /housekeeping in a repo with merged branches, merged worktrees of idle unarchived sessions, dirty merged worktrees, unmerged worktrees and another repo's worktree
cases.required_behavior: Remove nothing before approval; parts A-F; unmerged kept; session worktrees archived through the host only after their files are resolved; ask part by part
cases.run_2026_11_15: PASS on the core behavior with one Sonnet agent; three unclear places fixed afterwards, not re-run
